_comment: MCP servers for CLAUDE CODE (the coding agent) — NOT the same thing as
mcp_servers.json, which is the tool set the on-screen character's LLM calls.
Different file, different key name (mcpServers vs mcp_servers), different
consumer. Adding to one does nothing for the other.
2026-08-10: ported from the PC-A (Windows) version, which declared
chrome-devtools: cmd /c npx ...        <- 'cmd' does not exist on Linux
so neither had ever started on this box.
chrome-devtools attaches to an ALREADY-RUNNING browser via --browserUrl
instead of launching its own. That is deliberate: its own launcher cannot be
given ANGLE flags, and headless Chrome without them silently renders on
SwiftShader — no error, correct-looking screenshots, and every measurement
taken from it worthless for judging a GPU render. Start the browser first:
which refuses to hand back a browser that is not on the GPU.
'spector' (WebGL frame capture, draw-call level) is deliberately NOT here
yet: it is not published on npm (spectorjs-mcp / spector-mcp both 404) and
the PC-A entry pointed at a local source build. Add it once a Linux build is
verified — pixel-level work does not need it.
